# SkyBlock Translator 1.3.0

Minecraft **1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3**. Use the matching JAR, Fabric API and YACL. Fabric Loader **0.19.5+** is required. Java 21 is used for 1.21.11 and Java 25 for 26.x.

## New in 1.3.0

- Added a local-only mode using bundled, previously downloaded and user dictionaries. Online translation can be enabled separately for chat, NPCs, tooltips and world text. Google fallback requires an explicit opt-in.
- DeepL and Yandex have separate API keys. An existing key is migrated to the previously selected paid provider when possible. Test the selected provider from settings or with `/translator test`.
- Outgoing translation opens an editable draft. Review it and press **Send** to send it. Use `/translator draft` to reopen the current draft.
- Online cache entries expire after seven days and are keyed by language, channel and the service that produced the translation. Chat and NPC translations stay in memory by default.
- Added a local dictionary checker with match sources and regular-expression diagnostics. `/translator status` shows the active language and provider, dictionary state, pending translations and the latest error category.
- Language changes use the normal settings save action. Rebinding a hotkey preserves pending edits. Fixed a crash when opening the hotkey capture screen and a Minecraft 26.3 crash caused by the old saved unbound key.
- Preserve original chat click, hover and insertion actions. Apply translations after Minecraft inserts the original message.
- Limit network requests and response sizes, handle rate limits, and protect user dictionaries from partial writes. New profiles start with direct-message and outgoing translation disabled.
- Updated Gradle, Loom, Stonecutter and compatible Fabric dependencies. The release workflow validates all four JARs, declares the required Modrinth dependencies and synchronizes the project description after publication.

## Русский

- Локальный режим использует словари на компьютере. Для онлайн-перевода отдельно настраиваются чат, NPC, подсказки и текст игрового мира. Резервный Google включается отдельно.
- DeepL и Yandex используют раздельные ключи. Проверка выбранного ключа доступна в настройках и через `/translator test`.
- Исходящий перевод открывается как редактируемый черновик с кнопкой «Отправить». Повторно открыть его можно через `/translator draft`.
- Кэш учитывает провайдера и канал, записи действуют семь дней. Чат и диалоги NPC по умолчанию хранятся в памяти.
- Добавлены проверка пользовательского словаря и `/translator status`. Исправлены падения при назначении клавиш и входе в мир на 26.3 со старым профилем. Незавершённые настройки сохраняются при переназначении клавиш.

## Français

- Le mode local utilise les dictionnaires présents sur l’ordinateur. L’accès en ligne se règle par type de texte. Le secours Google peut être activé séparément.
- DeepL et Yandex ont chacun leur clé. Testez le service sélectionné dans les réglages ou avec `/translator test`.
- La traduction du chat sortant ouvre un brouillon modifiable. Validez avec **Envoyer** ou rouvrez le brouillon avec `/translator draft`.
- Le cache expire après sept jours et distingue le service et le canal. Le chat et les dialogues des PNJ restent en mémoire par défaut.
- Ajout d’un test du dictionnaire et de `/translator status`. Les réglages en attente sont conservés lors d’un changement de raccourci. Correction des plantages de l’écran de raccourci et des anciens profils sur Minecraft 26.3.

# SkyBlock Translator 1.2.2

Minecraft: **1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3**. Install the JAR and Fabric API/YACL builds matching your game. Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ is required.

## New in 1.2.2

- Fix inventory-title translation at the actual container label rendering calls, with version-specific injection checks.
- Preserve formatting/player/command placeholders when templating numbers, inherited component styles, and Unicode letters when comparing translations.
- Respect the ability-description, enchantment-description and rarity switches for standard item lore sections.
- Keep outgoing translations in order, fall back to the original message on failure, and prevent messages/translations from crossing server connections.
- Restrict the Hypixel-only option to actual Hypixel domains, and avoid translating in menus, singleplayer or background indexing when that option is enabled.
- Validate missing/invalid configuration values and language codes without overriding existing feature switches.
- Isolate language caches and reject stale API responses while switching language or clearing caches. Save config, cache and dictionary files atomically and avoid postponing cache saves indefinitely.
- Protect dictionary updates against language-switch races. Refresh derived item tables after downloads, preserve regex character classes, apply user phrase overrides and skip invalid replacement references.
- Add brief negative caching to avoid repeatedly translating unchanged text every frame.
- Make the technical filters effective and stop discarding meaningful messages merely because they contain a progress-style bracket.
- Make `/translator test` use the online path instead of a possible local dictionary hit.
- Rewrite English, Russian and French documentation for the current behavior and dependencies; fix project links, navigation and JSON examples. Add a multilingual Modrinth description and automated documentation/localization checks.
- Synchronize the public Modrinth description during release publication; report missing/insufficient credentials as a failed publishing step.

## Included from 1.2.1 — previously GitHub-only

- Fix the scoreboard startup crash on Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3, including the failure reported alongside SkyHanni (#3, #4).
- Fix offline matches when formatting codes split item stats or phrases.
- Apply Shift bypass and settings changes immediately to entity names, scoreboard and Tab.
- Remove stale per-feature caches and deduplicate pending component translations.
- Improve language cache isolation, support French/other Latin-script cache entries and use locale-independent dictionary keys.
- Refresh translations after dictionary edits and reload the selected language with `/translator reload`.
- Preserve nested bypass state, retry failed cache writes and prevent malformed API keys from exhausting request permits.
- Add regression tests and per-version mixin target checks; publish separate Modrinth versions for each Minecraft target.

## Русский

Версия 1.2.2 исправляет перевод заголовков инвентаря, обработку плейсхолдеров, переключатели описаний предметов, порядок исходящих сообщений, проверку Hypixel, конфиг, кэш и обновление словарей. Документация и ссылки обновлены на трёх языках. Включены исправления 1.2.1, ранее доступные только на GitHub: прежде всего устранение падения scoreboard на Minecraft 26.x и ошибки, указанной в отчёте с SkyHanni.

## Français

La version 1.2.2 corrige les titres d'inventaire, les marqueurs, les options de descriptions d'objets, l'ordre du chat sortant, la détection Hypixel, la configuration, le cache et les dictionnaires. Documentation et liens actualisés en trois langues. Elle inclut les corrections 1.2.1 auparavant disponibles uniquement sur GitHub, notamment le plantage du scoreboard sur Minecraft 26.x signalé également avec SkyHanni.

releases.notes:
Fixes startup crashes and translation cache problems.

- Fix the scoreboard mixin on Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3. This also fixes the startup failure reported with SkyHanni (#3, #4).
- Fix offline dictionary matches when formatting codes split a phrase or item stat.
- Apply Shift bypass and translation settings immediately to entity names, the scoreboard and the tab list.
- Remove separate stale display caches and deduplicate pending component translations.
- Keep late API responses from repopulating cleared caches or crossing language changes.
- Cache French and other Latin-script translations, and use locale-independent dictionary keys.
- Refresh translations after dictionary changes and reload the selected language with `/translator reload`.
- Preserve nested translation bypasses and retry cache writes after I/O failures.
- Prevent malformed API keys from exhausting request permits or leaving translations pending.
- Add regression tests and verify mixin targets against all four supported Minecraft versions during builds.
- Publish separate Modrinth versions for each Minecraft target instead of marking every jar compatible with all targets.

Choose the jar matching your Minecraft version: 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 or 26.3. Fabric API and YetAnotherConfigLib are required.
